## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- ToolAxisOptimizationEngine
- keeps tool axis near surface normal on flat surface
- computes gouge avoidance tilt for concave surface
- returns zero tilt for flat/convex surface
- gives high stiffness when axis aligns with force
- gives low stiffness when axis perpendicular to force
